_note: One settings file for every scene and episode of the navigation module. Values come from the robot spec, the memory scan or synthetic tests (the reason for each is in _why); none is tuned on evaluation episodes.

_why.grid.cell_m: 5 cm cells (spec); smaller than the 2-5 cm splat depth noise would only add noise
_why.grid.band_hi_m: obstacle band top 1.6 m: humanoid height about 1.6 m (spec)
_why.grid.band_lo: band bottom = max(2 cm, 3 sigma of the floor-plane residual measured on the memory scan) (memory_map.py records it)
_why.grid.min_views: a voxel / floor cell counts as observed when at least 3 reference cameras see a surface there (the same rule as whatchanged/splat/support.py)
_why.robot.reach_m: standing pose within 0.5 m of the target (spec)
_why.belief.decorrelate_s: frames within 1 s are not independent views: each perception tick's log-odds update is scaled by min(1, dt / 1 s)
_why.belief.cell_hit/miss: standard occupancy-grid inverse sensor model (Thrun et al., Probabilistic Robotics ch. 9)
_why.belief.p_new: calibrated probabilities are thresholded at 0.5 (checker calibration on held-out synthetic edits)
_why.robots: robot footprint profiles; the memory map's 'trav' layer uses robot.radius_m (humanoid)
_why.sim: simulated head camera: phone-like intrinsics = the memory video's K; perception at fps / perceive_every Hz; motion limits of a slow indoor walk
_why.robot.step_height_m: a legged humanoid steps over anything below about 10 cm: obstacles = mass 10 cm - 1.6 m above the local floor; low clutter between the floor-noise level and 10 cm is traversable but costed
_why.belief.min_box_px: a small item's box mask needs at least 120 px (about 11 x 11) to be evidence
_why.sim.scan_spin_s: doorway scan = one slow 360 degree turn on the spot
_why.sim.turn_dps: angular speed <= 30 deg/s with eased acceleration (<= 45 deg/s^2), so the head camera shows no motion smear
_why.sim.max_s: time budget 90 s: at the slower turn speed a 62 s budget ran out mid-search, before the search reached the far side of the room

robots._note: if no path exists at the default radius the planner retries the smaller radii and reports the shrink

scenes._note: Per-scene model files. By default a scene uses its own checker (<runs>/<scene>/checker/best.pt), feature PCA (<data>/<scene>/features/pca.npz), confidence calibration (<runs>/<scene>/checker/conf_calibration.json), no-change baseline and fingerprint match threshold (<runs>/<scene>/navigation/). An entry here, keyed by scene, replaces any of checker_ckpt, feats_pca, calib, nochange, move_match with a path (absolute, or relative to the runs root), or borrows another scene's file with move_match_from.
